baselines.description: Cold re-derivation: discovery probe + L=3 fresh observation fetches over LEARN_IDS=[11,12,13], distill_parameterized -> resolve -> execute -> verify the 5 TASK_IDS=[14,15,16,17,18] via the shipped carrier. The mandate's strong comparator and the ONLY cost/latency denominator. Timed per episode (t_cold_L3) in parity order against the treatment episode; arg deepcopy materialization inside the v4 timed boundary for both arms (placement symmetric, operand asymmetric by construction: reuse deepcopies the full mech dict, cold deepcopies {}; neutralized by the dual-boundary decider requiring strict wins on inclusive AND v3-exact NOARG at both L).
baselines.expected_outcome: task success 1.0 (V5 gate >= 0.90); shipped 4-field counter = 19 nominal at L=3 (exact per-episode vector (9,5,5,0); class sums pinned by V-DRIFT-COLD).

baselines.description: Identical to B-COLD but L=2 (LEARN_IDS_MIN=[11,12]), the carrier's minimum viable re-derivation. Mandate decision bar L=2. Timed per episode (t_cold_L2).
baselines.expected_outcome: task success 1.0; shipped 4-field counter = 18 nominal at L=2 (exact vector (8,5,5,0); pinned by V-DRIFT-COLD).

baselines.description: Replay the inherited (unrepaired) parameterized mechanism on the perturbed target. Establishes the perturbation actually bites (V4).
baselines.expected_outcome: success <= 0.10 on every class; if it succeeds the perturbation did not bite -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

baselines.description: Guard detects staleness but the system abstains from repair. Non-executing; NEVER a cost/latency denominator (V6).
Same reuse semantics as T-REPAIR-REUSE plus one carrier rebind (charges +1 retrieval_calls). Upper bound on repair cost; reported sensitivity, excluded from the classifier.

baselines.description: Prior system: separate guard probe read before the batch, full task batch re-executed after repair. Must reproduce the prior product-counter regression (V13/H7 premise).
baselines.expected_outcome: shipped counter ratio > 1.00 at L=2 (regression reproduces); failure is a reported validity caveat.

baselines.description: Treatment: freshness check fused into the first task read; after repair the reused probe observation is charged once (one repair_attempts, one repair probe fetch where the class emits one, one post-repair verify); first task id NOT re-resolved/re-fetched/re-verified. Timed per episode (t_reuse) in parity order against cold episodes; v4 timed boundary includes arg deepcopy materialization (full mech-dict operand) and all registry/guard/signal scaffolding, with the v3-exact S-ARG-subtracted boundary as gated co-decider (both must show strict reuse wins at both L).
baselines.expected_outcome: shipped 4-field counter = 17 nominal (exact vectors P1/P3 (6,5,5,1), P2 (5,5,6,1)) vs cold 18/19; deterministic premise V-EQ-HOLDS, episode latency compared empirically, not assumed.

decision_rule: Per class c in {P1-ENDPOINT,P2-STRUCTURE,P3-PERMISSION}, n=12 valid trials. functional_ok := repair_success>=0.80 AND wilson_lower>=0.60 AND contamination<=0.10 AND write_set_max<=1 AND guard_fire>=0.80 (same as parent). V-DRIFT-COLD (in-runner gate, checked before classification): per-class cold shipped sums must equal preregistered nominals exactly (M-SHIPPED-COLD-L2==216==12x18, M-SHIPPED-COLD-L3==228==12x19, M-COLD-HTTP-L2==96==12x8, M-COLD-HTTP-L3==108==12x9); break signals substrate/carrier drift -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (never a negative). The cold path is repair-independent, so this gate cannot mask a repair effect. V-DRIFT-REUSE (in-runner gate): every valid trial with repair reason repaired and repair success must ship exactly 17 units with class-expected http (P1 6, P2 5, P3 6 — the parent accepted vectors (6,5,5,1)/(5,5,6,1) on the byte-identical carrier); break signals reuse-side driver/substrate drift -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (fail-safe sequencing pin; genuine repair failures can never trip it because the pin constrains only successful-repaired trials, and charging semantics live in pinned v2 code). V-EQUIV (diagnostic, not gated): per-trial warmup original-function vs timed instrumented-episode discrete projections are recorded for audit recomputation. sp := M-SHIPPED-RATIO-L2<1.00 AND M-SHIPPED-RATIO-L3<1.00 (reported premise V-EQ-HOLDS; MEASURED from the run with PREDICTED deterministic 17/18 and 17/19 by arm protocol on functional_ok trials, verified by the V-DRIFT pins: a drift-checked premise, never an empirical win claim). lw := M-LATENCY-R-L2<1.00 AND M-LATENCY-R-L3<1.00 (inclusive medians) AND M-LATENCY-R-L2-NOARG<1.00 AND M-LATENCY-R-L3-NOARG<1.00 (v3-exact S-ARG-subtracted medians; dual-boundary empirical decider that prices all scaffolding in wall-clock while neutralizing the disclosed deepcopy-operand asymmetry). Class verdict first match: FUNCTIONAL-FAIL if !functional_ok; COST-UNKNOWN if any of the six ratios is None; PRICED-WIN if sp AND lw; PRICED-DEFICIT otherwise (an sp deficit without cold drift routes to DROP, never INVALID; a NOARG-only deficit likewise routes to DROP, never INVALID — the V-EQ swallow is removed). Aggregate first match: any validity gate fails (V0 pin, V1 freeze, V2 isolation, V3 determinism-projection, V4 bite, V5 cold live, V6 inert, V7 guard, V8 leakage, V9 integer counters, V10 not-fitted, V11 n=12, V12 base-liveness, V-DRIFT-COLD, V-DRIFT-REUSE, V-RETAIN-via-n-control, V15 contamination-instrument-live, V-TIMING parity/warmup/retention/dual-boundary/finite) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID; any FUNCTIONAL-FAIL -> FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL; any COST-UNKNOWN -> INCONCLUSIVE; all PRICED-WIN -> SUPPORTS; else (any valid PRICED-DEFICIT) -> PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED. Outcome mapping: SUPPORTS->SUPPORTS, PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED->FALSIFIES (bounded product-story drop, NOT a mechanism falsification), FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL->FALSIFIES (bounded functional), MEASUREMENT_INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE->INCONCLUSIVE. Prior predictive distribution (parent 36/36 per-trial latency signs against reuse, gaps 5-25%): PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED is the expected decision-changing outcome; SUPPORTS is arithmetically live but low-prior and is retained so the rule never assumes the answer. Attribution track (answers unknown#1, never gates the priced decision): per class, phase-median deltas reuse-minus-coldL3 with closure |S-MISC|/episode median<=0.20; component X ATTRIBUTED iff its median delta >=0.50 x median episode gap on >=2/3 classes; E<=0 -> ATTRIBUTION-MOOT; closure failure -> ATTRIBUTION-INVALID; else UNATTRIBUTED (honest unknown carried forward). Certificate track (B11 deliverable, independent validity V-CERT): coverage/false-accept census over the frozen 36-trial bank + 36 per-trial fresh-silence probes + 12 held-out guard-only perturbations + 2 NC probes; V-CERT failure invalidates only the certificate, never the priced decision.
estimated_cost: CPU-only, stdlib-only, no downloads, no external API spend. No Stage-A calibration (dropped: unit weights need no fitting). 36 trials x (2 warmup + 7 arms) on an in-process localhost server + NC trials + 12 guard-only held-out probes (fresh app, untimed, seconds) + certificate census reusing scored trials (zero extra timed runs): ~15-50 minutes wall clock, negligible memory. No credential, model, browser or network dependency. B3 model economics unsatisfiable on this substrate by construction; priced in counters only with the blocker recorded.
expected_information_gain: Terminal and decision-changing in both directions; this packet FORCES the re-admission vs permanent-drop resolution the parent left pending. The parent (audit PASS, MIXED-PARTIAL) proved a calibrated-counted surface favors reuse while wall-clock disfavors it, but its calibrated surface was quasi-structurally tainted (repair weight 0.000582 predetermined the win direction, knowable at DESIGN: audit AF-3) and its 0.2-0.9ms excess unattributed. This design (a) replaces the tainted fitted counter with the mandate's shipped 4-field unit counter framed honestly as a drift-checked deterministic premise (V-DRIFT-COLD + V-EQ-HOLDS, zero empirical variance by construction) with the empirical burden on the inclusive-boundary latency surface that prices every scaffolding operation in time, (b) attributes the latency excess across preregistered scaffolding phases with a closure gate, (c) exhibits the honest scaffolding-inclusive 5-field sensitivity, (d) delivers the B11 probe-coverage certificate with independent information beyond the gated bank (36 per-trial fresh-silence probes plus 12 held-out guard-only perturbations on fresh seeds), and (e) terminates under the mandate stop trigger: SUPPORTS re-admits localized repair to the C-PRODUCT-ECON story with honest denominators; any valid deficit permanently drops it with no further L-sweeps. The expected outcome under the parent predictive distribution is PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED with attribution — itself the decision-changing result the mandate stop trigger requires. Two new fail-safe instruments protect the terminal verdict's integrity: V-DRIFT-REUSE pins successful-repaired reuse trials to the parent accepted nominals (17 with http 6/5/6) so any reuse-side sequencing drift fails safe to INVALID instead of a spurious priced verdict, and per-trial V-EQUIV fields let audit compare original-function warmup vs instrumented-episode discrete projections. No existing packet provides the attribution, the certificate, or the terminating rule; the priced comparison itself is continuity (same substrate/carrier/classes/seeds), not a rerun of an equal-weight-only design loop.
falsifier: The mandate's re-admission claim FAILS (no re-admit; permanent bounded drop from the C-PRODUCT-ECON product story) if, with H1 functional/locality gates and V-DRIFT-COLD holding on every class, EITHER the shipped 4-field reuse-vs-cold comparison is >= 1.00 at L=2 OR at L=3 without cold drift (unexpected reuse-side extra ops -> PRICED-DEFICIT), OR the median episode-latency ratio is >= 1.00 at L=2 or L=3 under the v4 inclusive timed boundary OR under the v3-exact S-ARG-subtracted boundary (the expected deficit: 0.2-0.9ms unattributed scaffolding excess persists) - i.e. the SINGLE-SURFACE-MIXED split persists after scaffolding attribution and the mandate stop trigger converts it to permanent drop. It FAILS differently (FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL, bounded mechanism concern, still no re-admit) if functional/locality soundness itself breaks. It FAILS to decide (MEASUREMENT_INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE, never falsification, no drop) on cold-nominal drift, reuse-nominal drift (V-DRIFT-REUSE sequencing pin), perturbation-retention failure (V-RETAIN tripwire via n-control), any insensitive control, broken functional gates, attribution-closure failure affecting the priced surfaces, pin/freeze mismatch, or construction failure. The attribution sub-question resolves to UNATTRIBUTED (honest unknown) rather than falsified if no single component reaches the 0.50 share on >=2 classes with closure holding.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Denominator fixed in advance to B-COLD/B-COLD-MIN (same-carrier cold re-derivation at L=3/L=2) and pinned to exact nominals by V-DRIFT-COLD (216/228 sums, 96/108 http; cold path repair-independent so the pin cannot mask a repair effect); never the abstention control, never a single ratio. Treatment shares carrier/substrate/seeds/perturbations/target-rotation with baselines and differs in physical resolve/fetch/verify/scaffold counts plus wall-clock, evidenced by per-operation logs plus per-phase timings plus scaffold counts plus per-trial V-EQUIV warmup-vs-timed projections (V14). Conservative/legacy arms are reported sensitivities excluded from the classifier (legacy only as V13 replication premise). No counter is tuned: shipped 4-field uses preregistered unit weights with the deterministic-premise framing (AF-3 lesson); scaffold units are preregistered 1:1 counts; the 5-field sensitivity is informational and excluded for the stated arithmetic reason; latency is raw perf_counter on DUAL gated boundaries (inclusive AND v3-exact NOARG at both L, so the disclosed S-ARG operand asymmetry can only hurt the reuse arm, never manufacture a PRICED-WIN). Completeness: the triple (shipped counter + inclusive-boundary latency + v3-exact latency) jointly omits no cost dimension used by either comparator — auditable op dimensions in the counter, every residual scaffolding operation priced in wall-clock by construction with no weight choice anywhere (the only non-arbitrary scaffolding-inclusive measure). No ceiling/floor: success-rate 1.0 levels are functional gates, the deciders are integer ratios plus continuous latency with live dynamic range.

control_sensitivity.reason: Distinct non-tautological controls per failure mode, all inherited live from the parent PASS packet on the identical substrate/carrier and re-verified at DESIGN by fresh-path liveness (server/distill/resolve/fetch/verify/guard-silent/contamination-instrument/NC-silence all live 2026-10-15): PC-BASE-LIVENESS scored in-trial; B-LITERAL-REPLAY/B-NO-REPAIR must-fail; NC-NO-PERTURBATION/NC-NOISE must-silent; NC-OVERBROAD-REPAIR live (parent 4/4 every trial on this carrier; re-fired at DESIGN under the v4 import via --liveness-only: contamination instrument live on in-support probe id 14, out-of-support degenerate, NCs silent). Specificity pooled over 36 per-trial fresh-silence probes (read-only guard on unperturbed body, pre-perturb, untimed) plus 2 NCs. Sensitivity: the 36-episode bank is labeled as completeness census (same episodes as the functional gate — reported, not discovered) while NEW information comes from 12 held-out guard-only perturbations on fresh disjoint seeds plus the labeled residual boundary. Gates: V0 substrate pin (hash+size, refuse-to-run), V-DRIFT-COLD exact-nominal pin, new V-DRIFT-REUSE successful-repaired-trial pin (fail-safe sequencing tripwire), new V-RETAIN untimed post-warmup retention re-check per trial (guard stale=True required; discriminating canary verified at DESIGN on a discarded seed; failure marks the trial invalid via n-control), V-TIMING (2 warmups/trial, exact 6/6 parity per class, finite timings, dual gated latency boundaries), V-CLOSURE (attribution-track only), V-CERT (certificate-track only, bank 36+36+12+2 singly scored). No control is given the treatment answer; certificate ground truth (perturbed=stale by runner construction before the guard runs; fresh=silent by pre-perturbation read) is independent of the guard verdict. Failure policy INVALID-not-negative throughout; certificate/attribution tracks never flip the priced decision.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: The frozen pure classifier was driven with synthetic rows at DESIGN (non-substrate, non-outcome-bearing): all 4 class branches {PRICED-WIN, PRICED-DEFICIT, FUNCTIONAL-FAIL, COST-UNKNOWN} and all 4 aggregates {SUPPORTS, PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED, FALSIFIES-FUNCTIONAL, INCONCLUSIVE} produced (all True), strict-inequality boundary tested on all six ratios (1.00 is NOT a win), with dedicated PRICED-DEFICIT-noarg and PRICED-DEFICIT-noarg-boundary probe rows proving the v3-exact conjunct bites independently (an inclusive-only win does not classify as PRICED-WIN), aggregate FUNCTIONAL-FAIL-before-COST-UNKNOWN order matching class order. The AF-3-class determinism is confronted, not repeated: sp is a drift-checked deterministic premise (17/18, 17/19 absent cold drift) and the empirical burden rests on dual-boundary lw (six strict inequalities on live wall-clock medians, inclusive AND S-ARG-subtracted, no floor/ceiling). The V-EQ swallow is removed: V-DRIFT-COLD gates only repair-independent cold nominals, new V-DRIFT-REUSE gates only successful-repaired reuse trials (genuine repair failures exempt by construction), and an sp deficit without cold drift routes to PRICED-DEFICIT/DROP, never INVALID, as does a NOARG-only deficit (inclusive-win/NOARG-loss drops rather than merely flagging). The 5-field scaffold-inclusive sensitivity stays excluded (nominal ~27 vs ~21-22 deterministic deficit would make SUPPORTS arithmetically unreachable). Non-degeneracy dilemma stated in prereg section-1: shipped-only deciding is structurally reuse-positive, 5-field-unit deciding is structurally reuse-negative under an arbitrary 1:1 weight choice, so shipped-premise-plus-latency-decider is the unique non-degenerate structure; the defensive-unreachable sp-deficit path is retained for classifier totality and PRICED-DEFICIT remains reachable via latency, so no DECISION branch is empty. Honest prior stated: DROP is expected under the parent predictive distribution (36/36 signs, 5-25% gaps); SUPPORTS is arithmetically live but low-prior, retained to avoid assuming the answer; the packet is decision-changing via DROP + attribution + certificate either way.

Scope bound: does not execute the gated C-PRODUCT-ECON flagship; mutates no cross-lane claim status; produces terminal decision inputs for the Runtime DIRECTOR and Global Research Director; certificate schema co-owned with product for B11.

V-DRIFT-REUSE: every valid trial with repair reason repaired and repair success must show shipped reuse sum exactly 17 with class-expected http (P1-ENDPOINT 6, P2-STRUCTURE 5, P3-PERMISSION 6); break signals reuse-side driver/substrate drift -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (never a negative). Genuine repair failures are exempt by construction (the pin constrains only successful-repaired trials).

V-EQUIV-DIAGNOSTIC (recorded, not gated): the 2 per-trial warmups call the original pinned v2 episode functions and their discrete projections (warmup_reuse_success/shipped, warmup_cold_success/shipped) are captured alongside the instrumented timed episodes for audit comparison of original-function vs reimplemented-episode semantics.

null_control.failure_policy: Any false-firing guard -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Insensitive overbroad -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (the parent F1 failure must not recur). Cold-nominal drift -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (substrate changed, never a scientific negative). Reuse-nominal drift (V-DRIFT-REUSE) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (fail-safe sequencing pin; genuine repair failures exempt by construction). V-CLOSURE failure -> attribution INVALID only. V-CERT failure -> certificate INVALID only.
null_control.protocol: NC-NO-PERTURBATION: guard on unperturbed body must be fresh (stale=false). NC-NOISE: observed_at churn must not fire. Per-trial fresh-silence: read-only guard on the unperturbed body in EVERY trial pre-perturbation (36 probes, untimed). Held-out: 12 guard-only probes on fresh perturbations (fresh seeds, untimed). null_control.success_criterion: NC-NO-PERTURBATION stale=false AND NC-NOISE stale=false AND pooled fresh-silence specificity recorded; overbroad rate > 0.10 with probes>0; closure medians <= 0.20; certificate bank complete (36/36/12/2 known).
